clips.title: The story
paras: Bingles' Wrench is a vital piece of gnomish engineering gear belonging to the pilot Bingles Blastenheimer. Lost when Bingles crash-landed his flying machine into the Loch, it was hauled off by the local troggs alongside the rest of his toolkit.

After Bingles Blastenheimer crashed his gyrocopter into the placid waters of the Loch, his survival quickly turned into an ordeal. Troggs inhabiting the small northern islands raided the crash site, looting his specialized supplies and scattering his tools into various buckets across their camps. Bingles' Wrench is one of three critical hand tools needed alongside his high-yield Blastencapper explosives. Without it, Bingles has no hope of repairing his downed gyrocopter, stalling his planned aerial offensive to aid the exiled gnomes fighting to reclaim Gnomeregan.
